budgetNote: CPU time measured with std::clock, excluding initial model/pool load; final episode finishes. Same hardware, independent single-thread trainers. Episode counts intentionally differ. Shared fresh data collection cost reported separately.

b.method: V3 frozen plus two five-cell residual tables, 16 symmetry features, late stage only

c.method: TC per-parameter multiplier, signed/absolute error accumulation, alpha 2.5x A, late stage only

allArms.restart: shuffle hidden remaining deck; policy sees only visible information

collectionPolicy: V3 3-ply / 24000 nodes; first rank13 plus every40 moves, <=8 per source game
selection: highest 6144 screening wins among control/A/B/C; tie control,A,C,B; freeze weights before reading holdout results; no test-driven model tuning
promotion: positive matched-seed difference with paired 95% lower bound above zero, and browser compatibility checks pass
limitations: CPU-budget stopping means exact final episode count can vary between reproductions; saved weights and logs are authoritative.
A changes both dataset and training search; C also changes nominal learning rate. These are bundled interventions, not isolated causal effects.
browserGate: All legal results; V4 timed-vs-unlimited decision changes at most 5 percentage points above V3 on same representative positions. Shared board-only leaf cache optimization preserves fixed-node policy.
